title: D/B Upgrade AT-6 Storage Building Interior, Chiang Mai, Thailand
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC PACIFIC CMD.NAVFAC FAR EAST.NAVFACSYSCOM FAR EAST
detail_text: N4008426T4505 DB UPGRADE AT-6 STORAGE BUILDING INTERIOR, CHIANG MAI, THAILANDNO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT OR ANY FOLLOW UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. No telephone calls will be accepted requesting a bid package or solicitation. There is no bid package or solicitation currently available. In order to protect the integrity of any future procurement that may arise from this announcement, information regarding the technical point of contact will not be provided and no appointments for presentations will be made. Notice Type: Pre-Solicitation NoticeResponse Date: Wednesday, May 20, 2026, 11:00 a.m. Thailand TimeThis notice serves to inform the public about an upcoming project at Wing 41, Royal Thai Air Force, Chiang Mai, Thailand. The Government anticipates issuing a solicitation around May-June 2026. Additionally, this notice seeks to gather names of contractors interested in attending the site visit for the Base Access Request BAR, which will be facilitated by the United States Government. Due to host nation security requirements, the only way to access the site visit is through the BAR submitted by the United States Government. Any requests for site access after the response date will not be considered.For more details of the Pre-Solicitation Notice, please see the attached files
